blocks.t: Example 7 A delivery company accepts only rectangular boxes the sum of whose length and girth (perimeter of a cross-section) does not exceed 108 in. Find the dimensions of an acceptable box of largest volume.

Solution Let x, y, and z represent the length, width, and height of the rectangular box, respectively. Then the girth is 2y + 2z. We want to maximize the volume V = xyz of the box (Figure 14.51) satisfying x + 2y + 2z = 108 (the largest box accepted by the deliv- ery company). Thus, we can write the volume of the box as a function of two variables:
V( y, z) = (108 - 2y - 2z)yz V = xyz and x = 108 - 2y - 2z = 108yz - 2y2z - 2yz2.
